title: Adaptations
subtitle: ⚠ Experimental — writes module adaptation values. Backup + verify on every write.
kwp1281: On a K-line car only KWP2000 modules are reachable through a generic ELM327 adapter. Modules that speak KWP1281 — on older VAG cars often the instrument cluster, comfort and climate modules — cannot be addressed at all, so their adaptations are not offered. To reset the service reminder on such a car, use the manual procedure on the Service reset screen.
unavailableNone: Adaptation channels are unavailable for this car / link. They are experimental and profile-driven: UDS channels need a CAN link and KWP channels a K-line link — the current profile declares none.
unavailableOther: Adaptation channels are unavailable for this car / link. They are experimental and profile-driven: UDS channels need a CAN link and KWP channels a K-line link — the current profile declares channels, but none for this link.
unlockHelp: Off = read-only. Writes back up the old value and verify after writing.

row.loginPreVin: Login: needed — a code saved before this car’s VIN was known is available ({{address}} · {{purpose}})
row.loginDocumented: Login: needed — a documented code is available ({{address}} · {{purpose}})
row.readOnly: Read-only until a security-access plugin for this module is installed (Settings → Security access plugins).
row.readFirst: Read the current value first — writes always start from a fresh backup.
row.confirmText: Write {{value}} to {{name}} (was {{was}})? The old value is backed up and re-verified after writing.
row.prefillPreVin: Filled in from a code saved for this vehicle type before this car’s VIN was known ({{purpose}}) — check it is this car’s code.

login.title: Module login
login.help: {{module}} asks for a login code before it accepts this write — the five-digit number VCDS calls “Login – 11”. The app ships no codes: use the one from your own records or your VCDS log.
login.prefilled: Filled in from this car’s code book ({{purpose}}).
login.codeError: Enter the login code: up to five digits, 0 to 65535.
login.wscError: The workshop code is up to five digits, or leave it empty.
login.rememberOn: The code is saved in this car’s code book once the module accepts it, so the next write skips this step.
login.rememberOff: Not saved: the code is used for this write only.

msg.unverified: Write sent but verification failed — check the value.
msg.loginRequired: Login required — enter the login code for this module first. Nothing was sent.
msg.locked: Locked — enable the adaptations unlock first.
